title: Freeze nonvalidating undeclared-reference representation
api_or_output: Precise compatible unresolved content-reference identity/location/lifetime/pause and DOM/diagnostic contract, no runtime implementation or public stubs

acceptance.description: Freeze precise XML1.0 Fifth Edition EntityDeclared WFC versus VC applicability including no DTD, internal subset without/with PE references, standalone yes/no/absent, external subsets/PEs, declaration processing actually read, default attribute declaration-before-use and prohibited external/unparsed/recursive references. Independently assess original rmt-e3e-13 exact bytes/identity; do not label validity-only unresolved content as fatal, invent replacement character text, silently lose entity identity, or misuse unread external-entity notification as a mandatory unknown-entity callback. Preserve unchanged corpus applicability expectations and all existing required errors/resource denial semantics.

Publish one concrete bounded compatible contract for unresolved content entity name/lexical reference and location, borrowed versus owned retention, event ordering/splits/pause/cancellation, DOM representation and diagnostic outcome. Resolve current event representation limitation and Factories any-diagnostic failure explicitly. Compile independently authored representative contract/model consumers including old sink compatibility and owned retention, negative controls for mismatch, while preserving all existing frozen public model shapes and four declaration/name/attribute/namespace ABI shapes. No library runtime edits, shared build/project changes, public stubs, or premature shipped API baseline entries. Identify exact subsequent implementation paths and any additive public API/fixture approval requirement before implementation; routine compatible contract choices are within task authority.

Actual independent contract/model preservation and meaningful negative controls at known Git/source/binary/runtime identities, plus planning/ownership/diff validation. Source review separate from execution; no runtime/conformance/performance pass claim from model fixtures. Keep result summaries and source/binary hashes only, raw outputs transient inspected then removed. No unverified active peer dependency or later milestone requirement.

handoff.summary: Independent W3C4.1/source assessment: E13 nonstandalone internal-PE reference makes EntityDeclared validity-only. Existing event/DOM diagnostic behavior cannot faithfully express unresolved identity; freeze bounded compatible contract before grammar implementation.
